visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short dark hair featuring red under-dye is positioned against a soft green background with floating skincare bottles and a white flower. She gestures with her hands while speaking confidently, her facial expressions are animated and friendly. (2) The woman lifts a large prop newspaper titled 'BRAND NEWS' to cover her face before revealing it again, creating a playful transition. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her clear skin and the colorful text overlays appearing on screen. (3) She is seen in a different outfit, a professional white blazer, seated at a desk with several blue skincare bottles. She continues her explanation, looking directly into the lens with a helpful and authoritative demeanor in a studio environment. (4) A close-up shot focuses on a hand applying a transparent liquid from a glass dropper onto the back of another hand. The texture of the liquid is visible as it spreads across the skin, emphasizing hydration and product consistency. (5) The woman holds a white skincare bottle alongside a small yogurt-style drink bottle, drawing a comparison between the two items. Her expressions are cheerful as she interacts with these objects to illustrate her points about skin maintenance. (6) In the final sequence, she returns to her white ribbed top, posing with the prop newspaper and making a peace sign. The video ends with a clean white screen featuring the brand logo and a positive slogan in Traditional Chinese.
